messages:
Priya: AuroraEdge EAP kickoff  — partner requested tight NDA + bench window. Need owners for NDA, bench, telemetry, and marketplace blurb.

Tom: I can own the NDA edits. Partner insists on no raw prompt retention; hashed IDs ok. Will add 60-day retention + KMS requirement. Draft in 4h.

Alex: Lab window booked 6/12-6/16 (UTC). We'll run perf sweep + 24h soak. Hardware: 4x AE-60 boards with partner firmware. Need our benchmark list.

Dana: Recommend baseline suite: latency_small (`--seq=512 --batch=1`), mem_heavy (`--seq=4096 --batch=1`), long-chat sim (`--turns=6 --seq=2048`). Record `p50,p95,p99,gpu_mem_mb,kv_hit_rate`.

Priya: Telemetry: partner OK with aggregated counters only. No prompt texts. CI-Bot, attach checklist.

CI-Bot: Uploaded `drive.redwood.com/aurora/eap-checklist.md` with telemetry schema and run scripts.

Tom: NDA clause: "Only aggregated telemetry and cryptographic hashes of request IDs may be exchanged. No plaintext prompts or responses stored outside ephemeral test artifacts. Artifacts retained up to 60 days and encrypted with KMS." Adding now.

Alex: Example run command: `./bench --model=redwood-7b --seq=2048 --batch=1 --samples=250 --cache=on` output saved as `aurora_20240612_warm.json`. We'll capture cold (`--cache=off`) and warm.

Dana: Note: include `kv_hit_rate` & `cache_fill_seconds` in logs. Also record perf under resource-constrained mode (`--gpu_mem_limit=24GB`).

Priya: Marketplace ops: need 75-100 word blurb, partner logo, and approved quote by 6/20 to aim for co-listing. Dana, can you draft the blurb?

Dana: Yep, I'll draft and ping comms for quote template.

Priya: Action items recap: Tom -> NDA draft; Alex -> run bench + upload artifacts by 6/14; Dana -> blurb draft + quote ask; CI-Bot -> keep checklist updated. Sync Friday 9am UTC to review artifacts.

Tom: Pinging legal for expedited review after draft.

Alex: Will include runbook and minimal reproduce steps. Will tag here when artifacts live.

Priya: Thanks — keeping all EAP ops in this thread. :tada:
